post.summary: Migrate live instances to another version (or dry-run the plan)
post.description: Each instance is closed out (status `migrated`, open tasks cancelled, queued resumes dropped) and a new run starts on the target version at the chosen node with the same variables, trace and task (a User Task there creates a fresh task). Target node per instance: node_map[current node] → default_target_node_id → the node with the same id. Results are per instance; an instance that changed since planning is reported as a conflict and left alone.

post.description: Workflow tasks are actioned by their assignee only (a member of the assigned team for a team task).
